entries.name: JM_SHIPPING_API_KEY
entries.description: The API key JM Shipping Solution issued the store, a GUID, sent in the API_KEY header and as the user name of the basic credentials to list and read the store's shipments, tracking, claims and reconciled charges. JM documents no scopes, so the key can also buy labels and file claims; the connector only ever sends GET requests.
howToGet: Email JM Shipping Solution at shipping@jminsure.com from the store's account and ask for API credentials for an integration that only reads shipments, tracking, claims and reconciliation.
JM issues a key and a password for the store. Ask JM whether it can limit them to reading; its docs name no scopes.
Copy the key straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: JM_SHIPPING_PASSWORD
entries.description: The password JM Shipping Solution issued with the API key, sent only inside the basic credentials of each GET request.
howToGet: JM issues it with the key. Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: JM_SHIPPING_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The store's JM Shipping Solution client id, a whole number, which the shipment and reconciliation lists take in their path.
howToGet: Ask JM for the store's client id when it issues the key and password.

entries.name: JM_SHIPPING_API_BASE
entries.description: The https address of the JM Shipping Solution host the credentials are for, on transguardian.com, with no path. JM's docs show only its UAT host, https://uat2.transguardian.com, which is used when this is unset.
howToGet: Ask JM which host the store's credentials are for when it issues them, and set it here unless it is the UAT host.
